question: What representational resource accounts for the remaining full-resource target-state gap: outside-basis identity diversity (A), a second outside dimension (B), or within-support target orientation (C)?

B_outside_dimension.require: numerical rank>=D, B_OUT orthonormal, W_target.T B_OUT ~0; else cell non-evaluable -> technical inconclusive; do NOT substitute D

C_within_support_orientation.C1: P_SUPPORT_ORACLE_R = W_target U[:, :r_best](Z.T) (Z.T)^T ... training-only target-informed rank-matched WITHIN-support oracle (O2.5); CAPACITY diagnostic, NOT an operational/zero-shot estimator

factor_A_meaning: identity diversity for ESTIMATING the outside-support basis ONLY; Factor C independently uses all 10 outer-training identities for the within-support oracle; this is a REPRESENTATIONAL CAPACITY decomposition, not an acquisition-cost decomposition

combined_projector.orthogonal_ranges: range(P_IN_C) in col(W_target), range(P_OUT) perp col(W_target)

eval.on: 2 held-out target-native imagery residuals; M2 avg over 25 pairs within fold; M10 one basis/fold; fold->participant BEFORE group

replay_gates.O2_8_BASELINE_REPLAYS_O2_7A_T8: R000 reproduces sealed O2.7A R_AXIS_8 participant values <=1e-10 (same 25 pairs / 6 folds / b8 / P_ZERO / held-out); else STOP
replay_gates.O2_8_SUPPORT_ORACLE_REPLAYS_O2_5: P_SUPPORT_ORACLE_R (no outside) reproduces sealed O2.5 R_SUPPORT_ORACLE_R <=1e-10; else STOP

remaining_gap.require_evaluable: >=7/8 per ROI for normalized group interpretation

full_closure.UNEXPLAINED_FRACTION: (R_NATIVE_ORACLE-R111)/max(G_REMAIN,1e-12) UNCLIPPED (values may be negative if R111 exceeds oracle)

shapley.efficiency: phi_A + phi_B + phi_C == R111 - R000 within 1e-12 (else STOP implementation failure)

normalized_fractions.F_i: phi_i / G_REMAIN (unclipped for inference-adjacent reporting; clipped for viz only)

component_supported: SUPPORTED within ROI iff median phi_i>0 AND >=6/8 phi_i>0 AND Holm reject; else NOT_SUPPORTED (not exactly zero)

roi_mechanism_status.RESIDUAL_CAPACITY_BEYOND_TESTED_FACTORS: tested set does not close majority remaining gap
roi_mechanism_status.CAPACITY_INTERACTION_DOMINANT: none individually supported but full closure>=0.50

program_status.RESIDUAL_CAPACITY_MULTICOMPONENT: both resolved but require >=2 components, or resolved mechanisms differ
program_status.RESIDUAL_CAPACITY_BEYOND_TESTED_FACTORS: either ROI fails majority-gap closure (tested set insufficient)

claim_boundaries.A: greater identity diversity improves ESTIMATION of the tested outside-support subspace; NOT 'brain needs 10 identities'
claim_boundaries.B: a second native direction outside the tested support accounts for additional held-out structure; NOT 'imagery has two special neural dimensions'
claim_boundaries.C: target-informed orientation within the tested support accounts for additional held-out structure; NOT 'perception/imagery share a causal latent operator'
claim_boundaries.C1_is_oracle: uses target-state training data; CAPACITY DIAGNOSIS only; if C supported the NEXT gate designs a stable within-support estimator (O2.8 authorizes none)

next_gate.RESIDUAL_CAPACITY_WITHIN_SUPPORT_ORIENTA: O2.9 STABLE WITHIN-SUPPORT TARGET-ORIENTATION ESTIMATOR (no underdetermined M2 Procrustes)
next_gate.RESIDUAL_CAPACITY_MULTICOMPONENT: O2.9 MINIMAL COMPOSITE TARGET-STATE CALIBRATION (only supported components)
next_gate.RESIDUAL_CAPACITY_BEYOND_TESTED_FACTORS: O2.9 RESIDUAL STRUCTURE EXPANSION DIAGNOSTIC (D>2 / identity-conditioned / rank mismatch / remaining native structure, before nonlinear)
